ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity black pixels localized primarily at the trailing edge, median notch, and scattered focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ventral surface consists of large contiguous high-intensity white blobs. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and a dense cluster at the peduncle-notch interface. Discrete, circular low-intensity spots are distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex angle and significant depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude irregular serrations are present along the entire continuous trailing edge, creating a jagged, saw-tooth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows an upward convex curve from the median notch toward the terminal tips of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous localized circular high-contrast pixel clusters (dark outer rings with lighter centers) are distributed across the white surface. Densely packed, high-relief white-on-black clusters (barnacles) are present at both fluke tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible, including long vertical strokes on the inner right lobe and shorter diagonal marks on the lateral left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization at both distal tips; multiple circular target-pattern scars and vertical rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged and irregular trailing edge topography compared to smooth species-typical contours.
